info.name: eo-be Phase 4-6
info.description:
Collection test day du API eo-be (Endpoints.java).

Cach dung:
1. Import collection + environment eo-be local
2. Chon environment eo-be local
3. Login admin truoc khi goi API can JWT

Tai khoan:
- Admin: admin@toeic.local / Admin@123
- User: user@toeic.local / User@123

request.description: Chay request nay truoc. Token duoc luu vao {{token}}.
User mau ROLE_USER. Cac API create skill/topic/exam/question se bi tu choi. Dung de so sanh voi admin.
Dang ky xong dang nhap duoc ngay, khong can ma OTP.
Giu nguyen password admin de test tiep. Doi neu muon thu that.
Reset code in console BE (Temporary password for ...). Gan vao {{resetCode}}.
Khong can JWT. Tra Listening/Reading + Part 1-7. Luu id seed vao bien.
Gan chu de seed vao skill vua tao. Chay Create skill truoc.
Chi xoa skill vua tao, khong xoa Listening/Reading.
Gan de thi vao chu de vua tao. Chay Create topic + Create exam truoc.
topicId lay tu Skill header. Exam se duoc append vao topic.examIds.
Gan question vao de thi. Chay Create exam + Create question truoc.
Chay sau khi da test xong question. Soft-delete exam vua tao.
Question duoc append vao exam.questionIds. Dung Create exam truoc.

exec: const other = users.find(u => u.email !== pm.collectionVariables.get('adminEmail')) || users[0];

request.description: Khong block admin. Dung userId tu List users hoac Register.
Danh sach de thi thu. Can JWT. Restart BE de Mongock seed nhieu de.
Chi tiet 1 de thi thu: Part 1-7, 200 cau, 120 phut. Can JWT.
Quy doi so cau dung Listening/Reading (0-100) sang diem TOEIC.
Luu progress thi thu. status=1 la complete.
multipart field name = file. Anh vao data/images, audio vao data/sounds. mediaUrl la /data/... de gan vao question.image hoac question.sound.
Mo file tinh. Chay Upload truoc. URL dang http://localhost:8080/data/images/foo.png
fileURL co the la /data/images/foo.png hoac path o dia.
